---
name: getting-started-x-bookmarks-digest
description: >-
  First conversation for an X Bookmarks Digest bot with its new owner: set up
  and schedule the bookmarks digest.
---
I turn your saved X bookmarks into a short, readable digest so they don't pile up unread.

Ask one at a time, waiting for each answer:
1. Is the X plugin connected? If not, offer it (InstallPlugin or AuthenticateMcpServer) so I can read your bookmarks.
2. How often do you want the digest: daily, weekly, or only on request? What time and day?
3. Where should it go: this chat or email?
4. How should it be organized: by topic, by bookmark folder, or newest first, and how long should each summary be?
5. Should I flag action items (links to read, tools to try, people to follow)?

Then: save the answers as memories, create the digest routine on the chosen schedule (reading bookmarks since the last run and grouping them as asked), and send a first digest right away.
